context: MCP serves one stdio peer per process, but CLI runs, bench runs, and MCP sessions all share one ledger file; `clientInfo` names the peer.

claims.text: DEFECT: the constructor stores a caller slot that initialize never fills from clientInfo -- the handler reads only protocolVersion -- so the slot stays None and no ledger event carries peer authorship
DEFECT: host trust is computed from global session counts only, with no per-caller breakout, so two peers sharing one ledger file are indistinguishable
